card.title: Iron Morning
card.instruments: one distorted guitar, sparse drums, bass
card.lyrics:
[verse]
They built the wall before I learned to climb
Told me it was mine told me it was mine

I am not asking anymore
I am the knocking at the door
I am not asking anymore
Iron morning iron morning
card.note: Density experiment: same lyrics, key, tempo and seed as iron_morning, with a thinner band. Testing whether arrangement density is what buries the vocal.
